name: A1 SIP Trunk
host_hint: A1's servers can only be reached through A1's own network and router, not from the internet.
notes: For the registering connection. Needs AiPBX 1.60.8 or newer. The user name is your main number as +43..., without an extension; password and addresses are on your A1 customer data sheet. Choose Austria below. Route 193.81.5.0/27 and 193.81.7.0/27 through the A1 router and let its DNS answer, and turn off the router's SIP helper. Faxes go over G.711. Written from A1's guideline version 4.1 of 2019; A1 has newer versions, and it advises agreeing the setup with its technician.
